notes.title: Settings update
notes.content: Fixed various bugs with controller support and video/sound options menu. Menu system should now be fully functional with a controller.

notes.title: Alpha 1.1 hotfix
notes.content: Fixed "Missing EXE" issue, which was preventing game from launching directly from Steam.

notes.title: ALPHA 1.1 Released
notes.content:
[h1]Alpha 1.1 has been released![/h1]

[list]
[*] Full controller support
[*] Better controller mapping
[/list]

[h2]New Level Added - Moon Base[/h2]

Featuring low gravity, the moon base is the perfect place to play around. Multiple heights and angles to choose from, and plenty of room to drift the go-kart around!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44538049/5d0638040e37d8cb7832b9e5740f3c5666a3da12.png[/img]

notes.title: Expect an update this week!
notes.content:
I wanted to give a quick update about what I've been working on. Along with with various bug fixes, I'll be adding some new content as well as compatibility.  

The next update will be released within the next week! The focus of this update is to add [b]full controller support[/b]!

There will also be a new level added. Can you guess where it is?

[url=https://snazzygoldfish.com][img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44538049/5d0638040e37d8cb7832b9e5740f3c5666a3da12.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Update 1.01: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[h1]Fixed various bugs:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Player can now use controller and keyboard/mouse simultaneously. A previous bug was preventing the keyboard/mouse from working when a controller was plugged in.
[*] Fixed a few stretched textures.
[*] Fixed loud audio in "City Courtyard" level. It should no longer rupture your eardrums.
[*] Added physics material to various colliders.
[/list]

[h2]Next update to-do list:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Better controller support (Controllers currently work but the mapping is awful)
[*] Night version of large city 
[/list]

Note: Thank you all for your patience, and thank you for buying Hoops World! I have a couple new levels that are close to finished, and a lot of ideas I'd like to try.
